name: Fujin
title: Guardian of Air
summary: Use Wind Strikes to Deflect AoE Damage and Protect your Allies from Debuffs and Disables.
lore: Both demon and god, Fujin carries the Four Winds, using them to fly and leaving powerful gusts and gales in his wake. Although a source of destruction, Fujin is not a being of evil per se. Rather, Fujin simply does not care, traveling where he will and brawling with whoever he likes, in utter disregard of the damage his winds cause.
archetype_description: Reduce incoming damage by 1% for each piece of plate armor attuned

Reflect 25% of the reduced damage back to the attacker. If Raijin is an ally, reflect 100% of the damage reduced by him.
Transfer all Debuff from all allies instead. If Raijin is an ally, increase his Turn Meter by 20% for each Debuff transferred.
